events.verdict: Ferguson (OKC) makes incidental contact with Aldridge (SAS) during rebounding without affecting his ability to retrieve the loose ball.
Aldridge (SAS) makes marginal contact with Westbrook's (OKC) forearm during rebounding.
Bertans (SAS) makes "high-five" contact with Ferguson (OKC) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Aldridge (SAS) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor at the start of his dribble.
Ferguson (OKC) and Bertans (SAS) engage and disengage off-ball without affecting the other's FOM.
Bertans (SAS) sets the pick on Grant (OKC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Grant (OKC) reflexively places his arm around Bertans' (SAS) midsection but immediately slides it off.
[Observable in enhanced video] Forbes (SAS) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Grant (OKC) jumps into White's (SAS) body as he is mid-air and creates contact that affects his ability to pass. White passes the ball to the corner and the play is correctly deemed a personal foul.
Forbes (SAS) establishes himself in Grant's (OKC) path and does not deliver contact.
RLS shows Westbrook (OKC) initiates some contact with White's (SAS) body but does not affect his SQBR.
Westbrook (OKC) legally contests White's (SAS) driving shot attempt.
RLS shows Grant (OKC) establishes himself in a wide screening position in White's (SAS) defensive path and delivers leg-to-leg contact that affects his ability to defend.
Grant (OKC) makes "high-five contact with DeRozan (SAS) after the release of his jump shot attempt.

Grant (OKC) and Aldridge (SAS) engage and disengage off-ball without affecting the other's FOM.
Aldridge (SAS) hedges the pick and makes marginal contact with Westbrook (OKC) that does not affect his SQBR.

Westbrook (OKC) makes marginal contact with Belinelli's (SAS) arm that does not affect his ability to maintain possession along the sideline.
George (OKC) cleanly strips Belinelli (SAS) of the ball along the sideline.
